title: Root-active high-resolution Reference qualification for minimal Layer-ROM Feddes feedback
scientific_question: Can a fresh root-active fixed-flux Reference panel, using the admitted committed-state drought-only Feddes process, support a qualified three-level space-time numerical uncertainty authority before any reduced root-feedback trajectory is generated?

synthetic_root_contract.purpose: Mechanistic root-feedback qualification only; not crop calibration or application acceptance.
synthetic_root_contract.fine_process: Use evaluate_macro_feddes_drought_uptake unchanged. h3 is derived by the production process from T_p and the frozen breakpoints.
synthetic_root_contract.evaluation_timing: At the start of every Reference transaction, evaluate root uptake from the current committed pressure-head state, then hold the resulting root sink vector fixed during that transaction.

numerical_authority.reason: The legacy DYN0A fallback has not been independently admitted for dynamically reevaluated root-active Reference forcing. C6R may not extend that policy after response.
numerical_authority.segmentation: R2048_T32 may use the already-qualified C6N1 checkpoint topology, because root sink is recomputed from committed hydraulic state and is not persistent checkpoint state.

qualification.method: Identical three-level monotone Richardson/GCI-style structure to C6N1, evaluated separately for each material and each frozen metric.
axis_rule: E_coarse and E_fine must be finite, positive and E_fine<E_coarse.
p=log2(E_coarse/E_fine) must be finite and positive.
qualification.pass_rule: All five metrics qualify on both axes for both B01 and B14, with integrity and O0/O2 gates green.
qualification.if_passed: Authorize C6S prospective reduced root-feedback comparison using only U4,U8,R8,R16 and the frozen C6Q LAYER_MEAN_HEAD_FEDDES candidate.
qualification.if_failed: Stop before any reduced root-feedback response; do not change demand, root profile, retry policy, metric set or convergence formula after response.

stop_rules: No reduced candidate response in C6R.
No change to V01-V04, T_p, root distributions or Feddes anchors after first response.
No application tolerance or crop-calibration claim.

implementation_binding.binding_note: Root-process and root-sink-provider blobs are present in the same frozen C6N1 backend. R2048_T32 segmentation persists only hydraulic committed state and time; root sink is recomputed from that committed state after restart. Scientific cumulative uptake is reconstructed from interval uptake rates by the analyzer, not from a segment-persistent diagnostic accumulator.
